SHA-256 of continuation and analysis scripts, and digest of preflight.json.
Exact command, output, status, source and certificate hashes, S3 key and fresh-process replay result; uploaded after each case.
Source-bound first-fall certificate, uploaded by the pinned native binary.
Recomputed counts and source, certificate, and replay consistency.
Continuation scripts, preflight, input references, raw attempts, certificates, summaries and validation; source system bytes remain in the prior content-addressed store.
Archive and per-object S3 keys, sizes and SHA-256 readback outcomes.
